Hi Mina & Karthik,

Thanks again for the productive demo Friday. Our legal team reviewed the MSA and flagged the publicity / reference clauses for the pilot agreement (attached: EchoWave_MSA_redlines_v1.pdf). Two main asks from EchoWave:

- We need a clear embargo period around any press mentions and case studies tied to our public launch calendar.
- Logo usage: want to allow logo in a joint case study and on customer page, but need brand guidelines and a limited license clause.

I've attached our redlines in the PDF. High level: we can accept a mutual 30-day embargo post-launch, but want an explicit carve-out to use Redwood's name as a technology provider in procurement references. Also asking for a short approval window for quotes (3 business days).

Could you confirm Redwood's standard language for (a) logo/asset usage, (b) testimonial/quote approval process, and (c) whether Redwood needs a separate reference rights clause for sales outreach?

If helpful, we can do a 20–30 minute legal sync this week.

Best,

Hi Sophia — thanks for the redlines and for surfacing the asks. Attaching Redwood's standard publicity template (Redwood_publicity_template.docx) and an initial redline against your PDF (MSA_redline_echo_redwood_v2.pdf).

Quick answers up front:
- Embargo: Redwood typically agrees to a mutually negotiated embargo tied to "commercial launch" or "go-live". We prefer a single mutual embargo period (30 days is reasonable), with an option for both parties to agree to an earlier lift in writing.
- Logo use: we grant a limited, revocable license to use logos for case studies and joint marketing with prior approval of materials. We also require brand guidelines and a single point of contact for art review.
- Reference rights / outreach: Redwood asks for a narrow reference-rights clause to allow outreach to prospects for reference checks (no broader marketing use) — we will not use logos or quotes publicly without prior sign-off per the approval workflow.

Proposal: I suggest we land on the following and confirm via a short mutual action plan:
1) Embargo: 30 days post go-live; earlier lift by written consent.
2) Quotes: 3 business days approval window; silence = approval after 5 business days.
3) Logo license: limited, nonexclusive, revocable; approval required for public assets.
4) Reference calls: limited to case study/reference checks; we will not publish without written approval.

Can we set a 30-minute call with EchoWave legal and our counsel (Karthik & Olga) tomorrow afternoon? If you agree, I'll send a calendar invite and share the DocuSign starter package.

Thanks — Mina
Mina Haddad
Director, Customer Legal
Redwood Inference

Sophia / Mina — looping in a couple of short redline points from legal:

1) Embargo definition: please define "commercial launch" or provide a target date. If EchoWave prefers a calendar-based embargo we can accept a fixed date range instead of a post-launch window.

2) Testimonials / quotes: Redwood's standard is a 3-business-day approval window; however, we can agree to a 5-business-day silence-is-approval period only if EchoWave accepts a logo carve-out for procurement materials (internal use only).

3) Evidence requests: per procurement we will need SOC 2 / security attestation links. Please confirm the SOC 2 report access method (attestation link or shared artifact). This is standard for our security/compliance team before publicity that references technical details.

Inline suggestion (copy-paste for your redline):
"Publicity: Except as required by applicable law, neither party shall issue or authorize any press release or public announcement regarding the business relationship without the prior written consent of the other party, such consent not to be unreasonably withheld. Notwithstanding the foregoing, either party may use the other party's name in a factual statement that a business relationship exists for procurement/reference purposes, provided such use is limited to internal or prospect-facing reference checks and does not include logo placement in public marketing materials without prior approval."

If EchoWave is comfortable with the above, Mina and I can consolidate into one agreed MSA redline and send to DocuSign.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Senior Counsel, Legal
Redwood Inference

Thanks, Karthik / Mina — this is helpful. A few clarifications from EchoWave legal: we can accept a 30-day mutual embargo measured from the public launch date (we will provide a target launch date in the mutual action plan), and the 3-business-day approval window for quotes is fine.

Logo: EchoWave needs logo permission for a joint case study that will appear on our customer page (public). We are willing to adhere to prior approval and Redwood's brand guidelines. For procurement materials, we need the logo to appear in a one-page vendor matrix — this is still public-facing to procurement teams; would Redwood treat that the same as a "public marketing material" (i.e., requires prior approval)?

Reference rights: EchoWave will allow Redwood to conduct reference checks and to identify EchoWave as a customer to prospects. We cannot allow verbatim use of customer quotes without sign-off.

Attached is our updated redline (EchoWave_MSA_redlines_v2.pdf). We can do a 30-minute legal call Monday 12/6 at 10am PT if that works for Redwood (Sophia, EchoWave counsel; Mina, Karthik, Olga for Redwood).

Best,
